I added `openShifts` to `Rota`, just before `shiftsOn`. It filters `this.shifts` (which builds a new array, so the rota is untouched) to shifts with `staffId === OPEN`, `fromDay <= day < toDay`, and the given role if one is passed. It then sorts that new array by `day`, then `start`.

I couldn't see the file body, so I anchored on the `shiftsOn(day: number): Shift[] {` line and assumed it appears only once. I also assumed the class uses two-space indentation and that `this.shifts` holds every shift.
